title: Out of the quiet
note: The FY27 reset, for the branch group on Thursday 29 October 2026 and as the opener in the room on Friday. Cocoon to flight, geometric, never a drawn butterfly. Andrew Expressive, +0%, conversational.

scenes.say: Something's been building in this branch. Quietly. For months.
A new financial year, thirty days old, and every goal plan is in.
One sign-in now. One app. The system sets your day, and the wall shows the score.
This is the part where we come out.
screen: This is the part where we come out

scenes.say: Last week Akaash and I took this branch to the company. Our record, on the table.
Friday, twelve noon, we come back to you. Not to brief you. To hear you.
Everything you write before Friday is read in the room. In silence. Before anybody speaks.
The quietest person in this branch, read as carefully as the loudest.
screen: Every voice heard, with a structure

scenes.say: So open the meetings page, and answer three questions. Say the thing you'd say in the car park.
